roles_en: Minister of war of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Ախալքալաք։ 1906-էն Տարօնի մէջ Գէորգ Չաւուշի կողքին գործեց եւ եղաւ Դաշնակցութեան ականաւոր ղեկավարներէն։ Մահացած է Փարիզ՝ 1951-ին։
bio_en: Ruben (Minas Ter-Minasian) was born in Akhalkalaki in the 1880s into a prosperous family, the youngest of three brothers. In autumn 1904 he joined Nikol Duman's band and fought at Kotur on the Persian-Ottoman border, and in 1905 entered Vaspurakan, where Aram, Ishkhan and Koghbetsi Tigran were working. In late May 1906 he went to Taron as party organiser and leader beside Gevorg Chavush, later took part in the 1909 self-defence preparations in Constantinople, and returned to Mush in 1913 and again after the 1914 Erzurum congress. In 1917 he became one of the most authoritative members of the Armenian National Bureau in Tiflis, and he died unexpectedly in Paris on 27 November 1951.
